items.headline: Coastal Flood Statement issued October 27 at 3:08AM EDT until October 27 at 2:00PM EDT by NWS Upton NY
items.description:
* WHAT...Up to one half foot of inundation above ground level
expected in vulnerable areas near the waterfront and shoreline.

* WHERE...Southern Fairfield County.

* WHEN...From noon today to 2 PM EDT this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Brief minor flooding of the more vulnerable locations
near the waterfront and shoreline.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Localized minor coastal flooding is possible
during the early afternoon high tide cycle Wednesday.
items.instruction: Do not drive through flooded roadways.

items.headline: Frost Advisory issued October 27 at 2:02AM EDT until October 28 at 9:00AM EDT by NWS Upton NY
items.description:
* WHAT...Temperatures as low as 33 will result in frost formation.

* WHERE...Southern Middlesex and Southern New London Counties.

* WHEN...From midnight tonight to 9 AM EDT Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Frost could harm sensitive outdoor vegetation. Sensitive
outdoor plants may be killed if left uncovered.
items.instruction: Take steps now to protect tender plants from the cold.
